items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Howard. That's where I lived at. Was it named after some of your folks? Sure enough. No. It was named after another man. He was a doctor.

ctx.x: Yeah. You remember about where you were born and raised? What?

No. Around the streets? Around up around Palmer's Avenue. My street. Palmer's Avenue. Howard. That's where I lived at. That's where I lived at. Was it named after some of your folks? Sure enough. No. It was named after another man. He was a doctor. Old doctor. And they named after him.
What other streets? I don't even remember that street. Up in Carlton. That's where up in Carlton.
